notes:
- LumanoideOS 1.0.0, the first complete release, also as one installable package. `tools/make_package.py` builds the Shell and the release firmware and writes `lumanoideos-<version>-esp32s3-n16r8.zip`
- Setting up a new panel from a phone. A panel without Wi-Fi opens its setup network `LumanoideOS-XXXXXX` at once and keeps it on until the Wi-Fi is set; a phone or computer that joins it shows the setup page within seconds, as a hotel's sign-in page (on a Windows PC, open a browser). **Set up LumanoideOS** is a small page of its own from the firmware (8.5 KB, not the Shell, which took the internal memory down to 7.5 KB when an iPhone opened it twice at once)
- Recovery at the panel. Press **RESET 3 times** (about once a second, while the panel starts) to release the claim when the Device API Key is lost
- The demo is the boot animation. While no other content is chosen, as on a new install, the panel plays the chosen boot animation (Spin when it is Off) again and again with a second between, instead of the scrolling test text
- Factory Reset and Soft Reset work again, and a Factory Reset restarts the panel. Both wrote an empty content document that the panel refuses (no font) and answered 500 after clearing the rest; they now write the panel's default content. A Factory Reset kept the Wi-Fi connected until a restart by hand; the panel now restarts by itself and opens its setup network
